title: Bouncy boy flappy arms
author: willjameswaltz
selftext: I'm making a game and a game engine/editor (three.js, rapier base) in one and I just got procedural locomotion, full body runtime IK, foot planting, and runtime ragdoll all working together for this little bouncy, flappy astronaut. Thought you'd like to see it

comments.author: i_rate_slop
comments.body: It's details like this that will set apart slop from games with heart.

comments.author: No-Difference629
comments.body: I love the fog and lighting, the grass too is really nice looking

replies.author: willjameswaltz
replies.body: Thanks, its been a blast making it. I'm obsessed with orbital mechanics so I want to keep tuning those systems and make it really fun to hop from planet to planet with the little fella. We'll see how it goes.

comments.author: gamedevjp
comments.body: Gorgeous! I love the detail and that you understand what it is that you’re building

replies.author: willjameswaltz
replies.body: Thanks! Yeah it definitely helps when putting it all together. When things get super super complex its still good to have an editor to fall back on. We'll see how things evolve though :)
